turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi! How are the slides going? We present on Thursday.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: The slides? I thought you were making the slides. I finished the research notes yesterday.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Really? In the meeting I said I'd do the design. I meant the handout.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Oh, I see. When you said 'design', I thought you meant the slides. So nobody has started them?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: No, I'm afraid not. Sorry, I wasn't very clear.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Don't worry, it happens. We need about twelve slides. Why don't we split them? I can do the first six tonight, because I know the research.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Good idea. I work tonight, but I can do the other six tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. And can you finish the handout by tomorrow evening too?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Perfect. So I do slides one to six tonight, you do seven to twelve tomorrow morning, and we check everything tomorrow evening.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That makes sense. I'll send you a message when my part's ready.
